basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old student currently living in Toronto, Canada. I recently got into the world of PC building and gaming, which sparked my interest in technology and hardware. I spend a lot of my free time exploring new builds and learning about the latest tech trends. I also enjoy watching 'The Mentalist' and frequently share theories with fellow fans. I work part-time at a local electronics store, which gives me hands-on experience with various gadgets. I'm single and usually online during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge primarily comes from online research, YouTube tutorials, and hands-on experience at my job. I've been diving into the basics of computer hardware and enjoy learning about different components and their functionalities.
